name: socialCRM
tagline: A CRM for creators: an agent researches their audience and suggests campaigns.
problem: Creators can see follower counts but not who their audience is or why.
solution: Ingests messy social data, resolves identities across platforms, researches profiles with an agent, suggests content and tracks campaigns.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask the agent who your top followers are and get a campaign idea.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Rox: Best AI Agent” among 261 submissions.
Brings business tooling to individual creators.

lessons: Agent prizes reward agents that act on messy real data.
